plate_comment: Adds the step to cruise_speed_command, at most up to cruise_maximum_road_speed_cal (ACCELERATE: cruise_accelerate_ramp, BUMP UP: cruise_bump_up_step) (was cm848_protectionFuelRateRamp)
Takes the step from cruise_speed_command, not below cruise_minimum_coast_speed (COAST: cruise_coast_ramp, BUMP DOWN: cruise_bump_down_step) (was cm848_protectionFuelRateStep)
Returns the lower of its two arguments (a signed compare), as a word (was cm848_calculateProtectionFuelLimit)

On the power-down path (before cm848_runPowerDownSequence): cruise_saved_set_speed_cal = cruise_speed_command, or 0 while j1939_governor_feature_cal bit 0x8000 is clear (was cm848_initFuelRateFromCapability)

Power-up (cm848_applicationMain): when cruise_saved_set_speed_cal is between cruise_minimum_set_speed and cruise_maximum_road_speed_cal it becomes cruise_speed_command and cruise_resume_speed (valid flag set) (was cm848_validateFuelRateTarget)

Sets road_speed_governor_fueling (FUELING_STATE_ROAD_SPEED_GOVERNOR when it wins the arbitration) from the error between vehicle_speed_rise_limited and road_speed_governor_reference_speed through the RSG droop gains / offsets (0x1700 = no limit while j1939_governor_feature_cal bit 0x80 is clear, fault 29 (P0500 vehicle speed sensor) is set or TSC1 controls the engine); capped at adjusted_user_fueling + 58 while it governs (was cm848_calculateVehicleSpeedLimitFueling) | earlier note: Sets vehicle_speed_limit_fueling (FUELING_STATE_VEHICLE_SPEED_LIMIT when it wins the arbitration): from the error between vehicle_speed_rise_limited and cruise_speed_limit_working through vehicle_speed_limit_fueling_bottom_droop_gain / _d (5888 = no limit while j1939_governor_feature_cal bit 0x80 is clear, fault 29 (P0500 vehicle speed sensor) is set or TSC1 controls the engine); capped at adjusted_user_fueling + 58 while the limit governs (was cm848_processProtectionRampTimer)

The bumpless start of the cruise / road speed governor (also from cm848_arbitrateGovernedFueling): selects the gain set, sets the reference speed (road_speed_governor_reference_speed in state 10, else cruise_speed_command, or the road speed on RESUME / an external reset, plus the droop error delta), the clamped speed errors, the filter states, the fueling maximum pointer and the integrator / sump from the present fueling (was cm848_presetCruiseAndVehicleSpeedLimitGovernor) | earlier note: The bumpless start of the cruise / vehicle speed limit governor (also from cm848_arbitrateGovernedFueling): selects the gain zone (cm848_selectCruiseControlGainZone), sets the ramp target and reference speed (the vehicle speed limit in state 10, else the cruise command or the vehicle speed plus the droop error delta), the clamped speed error, and presets the integrator from the present fueling (was protectionRampRateControl)

The cruise control / road speed governor PID, every pass from cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs: the droop and preset fueling filters, the preset fueling window, the rate-limited reference, the speed error and its engine speed form, the proportional / integral (Q16) / derivative terms, the sump, and cruise_governor_fueling into adjusted_user_fueling; presets the governor on an external reset or an ACCELERATE / COAST release (was cm848_runCruiseAndVehicleSpeedLimitGovernor) | earlier note: The cruise control / vehicle speed limit (road speed governor) PID, run every pass from cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs: the reference and ramp target speeds, the speed error and its rate term, the proportional and integral (Q16) terms, the fuel demand delta into adjusted_user_fueling, the stable-speed and rate-correction timers; it presets the governor (cm848_presetCruiseAndVehicleSpeedLimitGovernor) when needed (was protectionOutputActuatorControl)

Looks up cruise_governor_gear_ratio_gain, sets cruise_droops_allowed_flag and cruise_droop_speed_error_delta, picks gain set 1 / 2 / 3 from the speed error after droop and the filtered fueling (with hysteresis) and loads its gains into cruise_pid_*_gain; a set change raises cruise_governor_bumpless_transfer_flag (was cm848_selectCruiseControlGainZone) | earlier note: Computes the cruise droop speed error delta and picks the cruise gain zone (cruise_speed_zone_code, with hysteresis on the zone thresholds) and its PID gains into cruise_pid_kp / ki / kd / rate gain working (was governor_cruise_setpoint_calc)

Passes the droop gains / offsets to the cruise and road speed governor fueling: the top droop gains for the selected rear axle ratio (two-speed axle), the cruise ones only while droops are allowed and cruise is engaged, and the top droop offset for the electronic smart power tau state (or from the peak fueling with programmable power) (was governor_cruise_speedReference_update)

The engine speed (1/8 rpm, clamped to 8000..36000 = 1000..4500 rpm) at vehicle speed argument 1 with rear axle ratio argument 2 in top gear (tire_revolutions_per_mile_cal x top_gear_ratio_cal / 60) (was governor_cruise_rampRate_calc)

A top droop gain: the droop width << 10 / (the 4D transient fueling at 100 % throttle and the given engine speed - cruise_top_droop_offset_tau_0), capped at 0x22c8; 0 when that fueling is not above the offset (was governor_cruise_tableLimit_calc)
A bottom droop gain: the droop width << 10 / the fueling span, or 0x22c8 when width << 10 is not below the span x 0x22c8 (was governor_cruise_rampScale_calc)

Power-up (cm848_applicationMain): the cruise and road speed governor top droop gains for both rear axle ratios (4D fueling at cruise_droop_reference_speed - the droop width), the bottom droop gains, the droop gains / offsets passed to the fueling, gain set 1 and the droop / bumpless flags (was cm848_initializeCruiseControlDroopGains) | earlier note: Boot pass (cm848_applicationMain): the power-up cruise and road speed governor droop gains and offsets (e2m 1187), the zone code and the deadband / zone transition flags (was governorCruiseStateMachine)

Calculates cruise_governor_speed_error_gain = ((tire_revolutions_per_mile_cal x rear_axle_ratio / 60) x 100 >> 7) x cruise_governor_speed_error_gain_multiplier >> 10, capped at cruise_governor_speed_error_gain_tool_upper_limit (was cm848_calculateCruisePidRateGainScale) | earlier note: Calculates cruise_pid_rate_gain_scale = ((tire_revolutions_per_mile_cal x rear_axle_ratio / 60) x 100 >> 7) x cruise_pid_rate_gain_scale_multiplier >> 10, capped at cruise_pid_rate_gain_scale_upper_limit (4900). governor_cruise_speedError_torqueAdj multiplies the cruise speed error x cruise_pid_rate_gain_working / 1000 by it (>> 7, clamped to +-10000) and cm848_runCruiseAndVehicleSpeedLimitGovernor does the same to its rate term. Called from cm848_presetCruiseAndVehicleSpeedLimitGovernor and cm848_runCruiseAndVehicleSpeedLimitGovernor. (was governor_cruise_torqueLimit_calc)

The speed error after droop in engine speed units: x cruise_governor_gear_ratio_gain / 1000 (at least +-1 while the error is not 0), x cruise_governor_speed_error_gain >> 7, clamped to +-10000 (was governor_cruise_speedError_torqueAdj)

Clears cruise_governor_external_reset_flag and points the driveline / derivative second order filters and the droop / preset fueling EMA filters at their e2m 1186 / 1189 coefficients (was initCruiseConfirmFlags)

While fault_reaction_request_bits is nonzero, ramps fault_vehicle_speed_limit down from the vehicle speed at the first pass by fault_vehicle_speed_limit_ramp_step to fault_vehicle_speed_limit_floor (else it is maximum_road_speed_trim_cal); road_speed_governor_reference_speed = the lower of that and maximum_road_speed_trim_cal; cruise_maximum_road_speed_cal = cruise_maximum_road_speed_trim_cal, or the lower road_speed_governor_reference_speed while cruise_maximum_road_speed_clamp_enable is set (was cm848_calculateFaultCruiseSpeedLimit)

Power-up: road_speed_governor_reference_speed, maximum_road_speed and the 0x40b5c0 copy = maximum_road_speed_trim_cal, cruise_maximum_road_speed_cal = cruise_maximum_road_speed_trim_cal, drivetrain_gear_range = top gear, the previous fault reaction request = 0 (was cm848_initializeFaultCruiseSpeedLimit) | earlier note: Resets the fault cruise speed limit: cruise_speed_limit_working, j1939_cruise_speed_setpoint and the 0x40b5c0 copy to cruise_speed_setpoint_default, cruise_maximum_road_speed_cal to its default, drivetrain_gear_range to 1 and the previous fault reaction request to 0. (was cm848_initTorqueCurveState)

A second order filter on an unsigned input with 32-bit products: output = (c1 x input << 16 - c3 x output_previous + (c3 - c1 + 0x10000) x output) >> 16 into its record (coefficient pointers +0 / +4, outputs +8 / +C). Its return value is (output >> 16) & 0xffff after output was already shifted down 16 (asm 0x56640 / 0x5664c), so it returns 0 in this build (cruise_governor_filtered_road_speed) (was cm848_interpolateTableLinearStep)
